Chocolate Banana Bread

Serves 8. Preparation 15 minutes, baking 55 minutes.

Ingredients
- 3 ripe bananas, mashed
- 75 g melted butter
- 150 g brown sugar
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- a pinch of salt
- 190 g plain flour
- 100 g dark chocolate chips

Method
1. Heat the oven to 175 C and butter a loaf tin.
2. Mix the bananas and melted butter in a large bowl.
3. Stir in the sugar, egg, and vanilla.
4. Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and mix well.
5. Fold in the flour, then the chocolate chips.
6. Pour into the tin and bake until a skewer comes out clean.
7. Cool for 10 minutes in the tin, then turn out onto a rack.

Tips
Very ripe, spotty bananas give the sweetest loaf. The bread keeps for three
days wrapped in foil, or freeze slices and toast them straight from frozen.
Walnuts or pecans can replace half of the chocolate chips.
